business.name: Ridgeline Roofing
business.tagline: Roof problems don't wait. Neither do we.

stormBanner.heading: Storm came through?
stormBanner.body: We're running free damage inspections across Eaton and Ingham counties this week. Most take about 30 minutes.

services.title: Roof replacement
services.summary: A full tear-off and rebuild when patching stops making sense.
services.body: When a roof is past twenty years, or the third repair in two seasons hasn't held, replacing it costs less than chasing it. We strip to the deck, replace anything soft, and rebuild with ice-and-water shield at the eaves and valleys. You get the old roof hauled away the same day and a written warranty before we invoice.
points: Full tear-off to the deck, not a layover
Rotten decking replaced and shown to you before it's covered
Dumpster and magnet sweep included
Most houses finished in one to two days

services.title: Roof repair
services.summary: Leaks, missing shingles, failed flashing, nail pops.
services.body: Most leaks aren't where the drip is. We find the entry point, fix the cause, and tell you honestly whether the roof has years left or whether you're better off putting the money toward a replacement. If it's the second one, we'll say so.
points: Leak traced to the entry point, not just patched below it
Flashing, boot and valley work
Photos of what we found, before and after
Honest call on repair vs replace

services.title: Storm damage
services.summary: Wind and hail inspections, tarping, and insurance paperwork.
services.body: After a storm we tarp first and assess second — stopping water getting in matters more than the paperwork. We document the damage properly so your claim has what it needs, and we'll meet the adjuster on site if that helps.
points: Emergency tarping to stop further damage
Documented inspection with dated photographs
We meet your adjuster on site
No pressure to file if the damage doesn't warrant it

services.title: Gutters
services.summary: Seamless gutters, guards, and downspouts that actually drain.
services.body: A roof is only as good as where the water goes. We run seamless aluminium on site so there are no joints to fail, and we pitch and place downspouts so water lands away from the foundation instead of beside it.
points: Seamless, formed on site — no sectional joints
Guards fitted where trees make them worth it
Downspouts routed away from the foundation
Usually a single day

services.title: Inspections
services.summary: A free, honest look before you buy, sell, or worry.
services.body: Buying a house, selling one, or just not sure how long you've got? We'll go up, take photographs, and give you a plain-English read on what's up there and roughly how many seasons are left. No charge, and no obligation to hire us.
points: Free, about 30 minutes
Photographs of everything we find
A number of seasons, not a sales pitch
Written summary the same day

howItWorks.title: Inspect
howItWorks.body: We come out, go up, and photograph what's actually happening. Usually about thirty minutes, and it's free.

howItWorks.title: Quote on the spot
howItWorks.body: You get the number before we leave the driveway. Written, itemised, and it doesn't change after we start.

howItWorks.title: Fixed price, no surprises
howItWorks.body: If we open the roof and find rot, we show you and it's already in the quote. Nothing gets added mid-job.

serviceArea.heading: Where we work
serviceArea.body: Eaton and Ingham counties, and a little past the edges when it makes sense. If you're not sure, call — we'll tell you straight whether we can get to you.

about.heading: Three trucks, eleven years, one county line either side of home.
body: Ridgeline started in 2015 with one truck and a ladder rack that didn't quite fit it. We still work the same way: the person who quotes your roof is on the roof when it gets done.
We stay deliberately small. Three crews means we can promise a same-week inspection and actually keep it, and it means nobody is subcontracting your house out to a crew we've never met.
We're licensed and insured, we pull permits, and we clean up. That shouldn't be a selling point, but here we are.

financing.heading: Paying for a roof
financing.intro: A roof is rarely a purchase anyone planned. Here is how people usually handle it — no offers, no rates, just the options.

options.title: Insurance
options.body: If the damage is storm-related, this is usually the first call. We document the damage properly and we'll meet your adjuster on site. We don't file the claim for you and we won't tell you a claim exists when it doesn't.

options.title: Payment plans
options.body: We can split a replacement across the job — a deposit, a payment at tear-off, and the balance on completion. No interest, because it isn't a loan, it's just the invoice in pieces.

options.title: Third-party lenders
options.body: Plenty of homeowners use a home-improvement loan or a HELOC. We're not a lender and we don't take a commission for pointing you at one, so ask your bank first — they'll usually beat anything arranged through a contractor.

options.title: Repair now, replace later
options.body: Sometimes the right answer is a proper repair that buys three or four seasons while you plan the replacement. We'll tell you when that's the honest option.
